subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Go down in flames
solution: The correct answer is **Option 1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Go down in flames"** means to fail in a very dramatic or spectacular manner. (बहुत ही नाटकीय या शानदार तरीके से असफल होना) • **Example: **The project **went down in flames** after the team failed to meet the deadline. • **"Fail spectacularly" **refers to a failure that is very noticeable and often involves a lot of effort or high expectations. (बहुत ही ध्यान देने योग्य असफलता, जो अक्सर बहुत प्रयास या उच्च अपेक्षाओं के साथ होती है) • **Example: **The business venture** failed spectacularly **despite the initial high hopes. Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is** "To fail spectacularly."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To destroy completely** (पूरी तरह से नष्ट करना): To cause something to be ruined or annihilated. • **Example:** The hurricane **destroyed **the coastal town **completely.** • **To crash and burn** (क्रैश और बर्न करना): To fail suddenly and completely. • **Example: **The new product launch **crashed and burned** due to poor marketing. • **To burn down completely** (पूरी तरह से जलकर खाक हो जाना): To be entirely consumed by fire. • **Example:** The old warehouse** burned down completely** in the fire. 2de:Tc47, The correct answer is** Option 3)**
